from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicRoute:
    pattern: str
    # Host-supplied routes keep MEDIA-731 semantics (stars span separators).
    # Set to False to require the path to have exactly the pattern's depth.
    span_segments: bool = True


DEFAULT_ROUTES = (PublicRoute("/teams/*/badge.png", span_segments=False),)
